$comment: Global pipeline defaults. Per-job overrides live in projects/<job>/job.json.

rough_cut.$comment_min_gap: Silence longer than this (seconds) between words is a cut candidate.
rough_cut.$comment_keep_pad: Lead/tail padding (s) kept around each retained span so cuts don't clip consonants.
rough_cut.$comment_merge_gap: Adjacent kept spans closer than this are merged into one segment.
rough_cut.$comment_min_segment: Drop kept spans shorter than this (usually breaths/clicks).
rough_cut.$comment_drop_low_score: Words below this WhisperX confidence are treated as likely noise.
rough_cut.$comment_filler: Filler removal is CONSERVATIVE by default — only standalone hesitations (um/uh/erm) are cut automatically. Discourse fillers (like/actually/basically) are flagged in the EDL note for review, not auto-cut, to avoid mangling meaning.

render.$comment_smooth: Cross-dissolve (video) + crossfade (audio) at every cut seam so talking-head jumps read smooth. Disable with rough_cut.py --hard-cuts.

graphics.$comment_bpm: Rough density target the planner aims for on long-form; short-form is denser.
graphics.$comment_codec: Per-beat overlays render with alpha (ProRes 4444 / .mov) so they composite cleanly.

music.$comment_levels: Three-stage loudness: voice normalized to -16 LUFS, music bed ducked to ~-23 under speech, final mix to -14 LUFS.
